body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Five test files in packages/gate-manifest/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/gate-manifest/test/key-ceremony.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the t parameter from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In packages/gate-manifest/test/migrate-branch.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'gm-salvage-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(root, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In packages/gate-manifest/test/migrate.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and update liveRepo to use tmp(t, 'gm-migrate-').
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
4. In packages/gate-manifest/test/spend.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace makeTmp() with tmp(t, 'gate-manifest-spend-test-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete local makeTmp and cleanTmp helpers.
5. In packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace makeTmp() with tmp(t, 'gate-manifest-usage-roundtrip-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete local makeTmp and cleanTmp helpers.
6. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove all 5 packages/gate-manifest/test/* entries from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicates packages/gate-manifest from the allowlist!).
7. Verification:
   - npm test -w packages/gate-manifest exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'packages/gate-manifest/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/gate-manifest/test/spend.test.mjs does not define makeTmp or cleanTmp.
- AC2 packages/gate-manifest/test/usage-roundtrip.test.mjs does not define makeTmp or cleanTmp.
- AC3 grep -E 'packages/gate-manifest/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 npm test -w packages/gate-manifest exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(gate-manifest): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate try/finally blocks in ceremony and migrate tests
